name: Initial-condition sensitivity
description: Robustness over a region of initial states. A neural MPC gives no recursive-feasibility guarantee, so this experiment samples the region: a 50-point Latin hypercube per benchmark, each point run to completion and reported as a success rate and a trajectory fan. The CSTR box spans ±15 % around its nominal steady state [0.2, 0.5, 120, 120]. The two-tank box is centered on the first-setpoint steady state, since ±15 % of the empty-tank state (0, 0) is a single point, and spans ±50 % to cover more of the operating range. Every configuration draws the same design points, so comparisons stay paired.
